svg.title: Figure 4-1. The ODD in the SOTIF view (WP-C-06 §4, §5; WP-C-02 §3.1)
svg.desc: The WP-C-02 ODD categories with the WP-C-06 triggering conditions in each. Road type: TC-13 (Needs modification), TC-31 (Needs validation). Geometry: TC-14 (Needs modification), TC-15 (Needs validation), TC-16 (Needs validation), TC-17 (Needs validation), TC-32 (Needs validation). Lane markings: TC-05 (Needs validation). Speed: TC-20 (Needs modification). Weather: TC-03 (Needs validation), TC-04 (Needs modification), TC-21 (Acceptable, with a stated condition). Lighting: TC-01 (Needs validation), TC-02 (Needs validation), TC-18 (Needs validation). Road surface: none. Traffic: TC-07 (Needs validation), TC-08 (Needs validation), TC-09 (Needs validation), TC-11 (Needs validation), TC-28 (Acceptable, with a stated condition), TC-33 (Needs validation), TC-34 (Needs validation), TC-35 (Needs validation), TC-36 (Needs validation). VRUs: TC-12 (Needs modification), TC-27 (Needs modification). Geography: none. Infrastructure: TC-06 (Needs modification), TC-10 (Needs validation). Connectivity: none. Vehicle state: TC-19 (Acceptable, with a stated condition). Driver state: TC-24 (Needs validation), TC-25 (Needs modification). Not an ODD attribute: TC-22 (Needs modification), TC-23 (Needs modification), TC-26 (Needs modification), TC-29 (Needs validation), TC-30 (Needs modification).

The category of each condition is an analyst input (TC_ODD in sotif_views.py); §4's own category column is coarser. A category with no condition is not shown to be free of them.

g.text: Terms: DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · eGPU external graphics processor (the optional big-model hardware) · GNSS global navigation satellite system (GPS) · HMI human-machine interface:

display, sounds, cluster · LD-SDA LionDriver Supervised Driving Assistance, the item · ODD operational design domain: where the system is meant to work · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · PCS

pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards with nothing failing · TC-nn triggering condition (WP-C-06) · VRU vulnerable road

user: pedestrian or cyclist · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
